summary_en: Finds matching cards in the specified locations, asks tp to select a non-cancelable Group of min to max cards, and immediately calls action(selected_group). Use during resolution, not during a chk==0 legality test. This helper does not select activation targets or store a target relation.

The public wrapper passes only a Card to filter and only the selected Group to action; capture other values in closures or compose a filter with RD.Filter. It emits a selection hint for public-location searches. If there are too few candidates or the selected Group is empty, it returns numeric 0 without calling action.

On a nonempty selection it forwards every return value from action unchanged. A callback with no return makes this helper return no values (nil in a single-value assignment); it does not automatically return the selected count or success.

summary_en: Registers a single-card EFFECT_UPDATE_ATTACK effect for nonzero, non-nil atk, and an EFFECT_UPDATE_DEFENSE effect for nonzero, non-nil def only when RD.IsCanChangeDef(card) passes. That predicate is card:IsDefenseAbove(0) and not RD.IsMaximumMode(card): it requires the core's valid, nonnegative DEF check and excludes Maximum-mode monsters. It does not block the ATK branch.

Both modifiers are created through RD.CreateSingleEffect with e:GetHandler() as owner, FLAG_ATTACH_EFFECT as label, and the supplied reset/forced values. No automatic duration is added when reset is omitted. Pass RESET_EVENT+RESETS_STANDARD+RESET_PHASE+PHASE_END for the usual until-End-Phase card modifier.
This helper returns no values and does not report whether the card's final stats changed. forced is passed to Card.RegisterEffect; leave it nil/false for normal effect-immunity handling.

params.name: player
params.description: Player used for protection and confirmation context.

params.name: reason
params.description: Reason passed to protection checks; actual movement is always REASON_EFFECT in this snapshot.

params.name: filter
params.description: Optional predicate checked against the operated Group.

params.name: count

params.name: expect

summary_en: Registers a hand Special Summon procedure requiring count matching other cards from hand. The condition checks capacity and candidates; the target step uses cancelable exact-count selection and retains the Group; the operation sends that Group with REASON_SPSUMMON and deletes the retained Group.
The filter must include the intended payment legality. This registers a procedure and returns its Effect; it does not perform an effect Special Summon immediately.

returns.description: Registered hand Special Summon procedure.

params.name: card
params.description: Monster receiving the procedure.

params.name: desc
params.description: Summon option description identifier.

params.name: filter
params.description: Hand-card predicate; receives candidate, effect, player. The summoning card is excluded.

params.name: count
params.description: Exact number of other hand cards to send.

params.name: value
params.description: Optional summon-procedure value.

params.name: position
params.description: Optional summon position; supplied through EFFECT_FLAG_SPSUM_PARAM.

constants.TYPE_LEGEND: Rush Legend type bit. The value 0x8 has a different meaning in standard formats; use only with Rush data and helpers.
constants.TYPE_MAXIMUM: Rush Maximum monster type bit. The value 0x8000 overlaps the standard Token bit; use only with Rush data and helpers.
constants.SUMMON_TYPE_MAXIMUM: Summon-type identifier used by the pinned Rush Maximum procedure.
constants.EFFECT_MAXIMUM_MODE: Custom Rush marker for Maximum-mode behavior; interpreted by the Rush helper layer.
constants.EFFECT_LEGEND_CARD: Custom Rush Legend marker, separate from the printed Legend type bit.
constants.RACE_ALL: All 32 race bits used by this Rush helper snapshot.
constants.RITUAL_ORIGINAL_LEVEL_EQUAL: Ritual material comparison mode: original Level, exact requirement.
constants.RITUAL_ORIGINAL_LEVEL_GREATER: Ritual material comparison mode: original Level, at least the requirement.
constants.RITUAL_CURRENT_LEVEL_EQUAL: Ritual material comparison mode: current Level, exact requirement.
constants.RITUAL_CURRENT_LEVEL_GREATER: Ritual material comparison mode: current Level, at least the requirement.
constants.RITUAL_ORIGINAL_ATTACK_EQUAL: Ritual material comparison mode: original/base ATK, exact requirement.
constants.RITUAL_ORIGINAL_ATTACK_GREATER: Ritual material comparison mode: original/base ATK, at least the requirement.
constants.RITUAL_CURRENT_ATTACK_EQUAL: Ritual material comparison mode: current ATK, exact requirement.
constants.RITUAL_CURRENT_ATTACK_GREATER: Ritual material comparison mode: current ATK, at least the requirement.
